facts.fact: The VENEEM platform has been introduced in Reo commune but is not operational for want of reliable internet, power and consumables, per a parliamentary mission report.

facts.fact: In Reo's secondary civil-status centres digitalisation is not yet effective and agents still work by traditional methods, with birth information recorded manually, per a parliamentary mission report.
